name: goyangi
description: A panel beside the Claude Code conversation: watch each turn's steps, tools, tokens, cost, and usage limits; hand work between sessions, coding agents, and browser tabs; and continue in a fresh session before the context fills (/goyangi)

autoOpen.title: Open the panel on session start
autoOpen.description: Opens the Goyangi panel when a session starts. If the terminal is too narrow, waits until it is wide enough

ctxAlertPercent.title: Context alert threshold (%)
ctxAlertPercent.description: Shows an alert when context usage exceeds this value. 0 turns it off

turnCostAlertUsd.title: Turn cost alert threshold ($)
turnCostAlertUsd.description: Shows an alert when one turn costs more than this value. 0 turns it off

stallSeconds.title: Stall threshold (seconds)
stallSeconds.description: Marks a tool or subagent as stalled, and alerts, when it runs this long without any event. 0 turns it off

sessionRows.title: Open sessions rows
sessionRows.description: Rows the Open sessions box shows before it scrolls (1 to 10)

tabRows.title: Browser tabs rows
tabRows.description: Rows the Browser tabs box shows before it scrolls (1 to 10)
